source: Geometry Resolution Hourly scheduler packets reconciled interactively

entries.subject: DPRK
entries.reason: A modern DPRK jurisdiction boundary can be useful as explicit context, but the forced-labour claim is not a whole-country prevalence polygon. Exact pinned PRK feature bytes/native identity and D-119 QC must be frozen before insertion.

entries.subject: Shang China
entries.reason: The scheduler established the correct source family and time-sliced polity semantics but did not freeze exact pinned source-native row IDs/intervals. No polygon is promoted from an inferred maximum extent.

entries.subject: Carolingian Empire
entries.reason: A valid Carolingian geometry requires exact component IDs and intervals through the Cliopatria POLITY/RELATION hierarchy. A hand-drawn or modern-France/Germany proxy is rejected.

entries.subject: Mycenaean Greece (Pylos/Knossos)

candidates.name: Palace of Nestor / Pylos
candidates.bounded_temporal_note: archaeological locus; palace destroyed around 1200 BCE; use only as evidence/site locator

candidates.name: Knossos
candidates.bounded_temporal_note: archaeological-site locator; use as evidence locus, not Mycenaean territorial polygon

entries.reason: Two point loci are defensible spatial anchors for the Pylos/Knossos evidence package. They must not be unioned into a territorial polygon or attached to the separate 'Mycenaean mainland Linear B archives' entity as if Knossos were mainland.

entries.subject: Brazil
entries.reason: Brazil already has an older reviewed modern-proxy geometry. The overnight evidence packet narrows practice to rural/property/enforcement contexts; the country polygon must not be promoted as the practice inference extent. Future mapping should prefer exact inspection/property loci.

retrieval_notes: The retrievable overnight Geometry Resolution checkpoints substantively covered DPRK, Shang, Carolingian, Mycenaean loci and Brazil.

Earlier handover notes mentioned possible PRC/CShapes, Peruvian Amazon/RAISG, Hawaiʻi and Funan follow-ups, but the exact completed scheduler packets/version/licence details were not retrievable as accepted overnight checkpoints. They are therefore not silently promoted by this reconciliation.
release_effect: None. Geometry changes require explicit database promotion and successor release selection after D-119 QC.
